user.title: Connect Codie
user.description: Enter the address of your Codie. The device must be switched on, unlocked and logged in. A pairing code will appear on its display.

data_description.host: IP address of Codie in your network, e.g. 192.168.178.112.

pair.title: Enter pairing code
pair.description: Codie at {host} now shows a six-digit code. Enter it within 5 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Codie again
reauth_confirm.description: Codie at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Submit to show a new pairing code on the device.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Codie. Check IP address, port and network.
error.not_logged_in: Codie is not logged in to a user account.
error.pairing_rejected: Codie rejected the pairing request. Wake and unlock the device and try again.
error.code_expired: The code has expired. A new code is now shown on the device.

abort.wrong_device: These credentials belong to a different Codie.
abort.signature_failed: Pairing succeeded, but signed requests are rejected. Check the clock of Home Assistant and the device.

say.name: Say
say.description: Codie reads a text aloud in the current character's voice (no AI answer, not stored in chat history).

config_entry_id.name: Codie
config_entry_id.description: Device to use. Optional when only one Codie is set up.

wait.name: Wait until finished
wait.description: Wait until the device finished speaking (max. 3 minutes).

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Queue a short message that Codie speaks when idle; it is stored in the chat history.

config_entry_id.name: Codie
config_entry_id.description: Device to use. Optional when only one Codie is set up.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show a JPEG or PNG image full screen on Codie.

config_entry_id.name: Codie
config_entry_id.description: Device to use. Optional when only one Codie is set up.

url.name: URL
url.description: Image URL (http/https). Either URL or path.

path.name: Path
path.description: Local file path, must be in allowlist_external_dirs (e.g. /config/www or /media).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show the image. Without a value it stays until replaced.

entry_not_loaded.message: No Codie is set up or loaded.

entry_required.message: Several Codies are set up; select one with config_entry_id.

auth_failed.message: Codie rejected the credentials, please pair again: {error}

unsupported_image.message: Only JPEG and PNG images are supported.

image_too_large.message: The image is larger than 8 MiB.

media_busy.message: Codie cannot show the image right now: {error}
